policy.warning_channel: Python warnings (stderr when enabled); never structured stdout
policy.exit_decision_reason: Implementations are canonical under redsentinel; legacy import paths remain as thin aliases until external consumers and archived reproductions satisfy the 1.0 removal conditions.
removal_conditions: repository source and active documentation no longer import the legacy path
legacy CLI, dynamic-import, and artifact-consumer scans are empty
new-path contract, integration, and regression tests pass
archived reproduction instructions either pin an old release or use the new path

imports.note: Legacy package and leaf modules alias redsentinel.attacks.engine; object identity is preserved.
Generic defenses are canonical under redsentinel.defenses; ecommerce and OpenManus integrations are isolated under redsentinel.adapters.
Evaluation, reporting, runtime and Product API implementations are canonical in their redsentinel domains.
Legacy profiling modules forward to the canonical redsentinel.profiling implementation.
The separately packaged SDK is a compatibility alias to redsentinel.adapters.engine.

cli.note: The deprecated all-in-one product/OpenManus demo is narrowed to the deterministic supported research evaluation.
Real-runtime behavior is retained behind the wrapper until a first-class CLI adapter command is available.

config.note: Credentials are deliberately omitted from the converted research manifest.

artifacts.replacement: legacy-artifact-envelope-v1 plus experiment-manifest-v1, provenance-v1 and evidence-index-v1

direct_legacy_dependencies.legacy_packages: Thin compatibility aliases/re-exports only; no new implementation logic is permitted.
direct_legacy_dependencies.third_party_exception: third_party/OpenManus and historical fixtures remain in place for reproducibility. Formal redsentinel modules do not import the old business namespaces; OpenManus access is isolated behind redsentinel.adapters.
